Stannah – A Company You Can Trust

The Starla 600 Straight Stairlift is the latest addition to the Stannah Stairlift family. Its specially designed seat makes it one of the most ergonomic chairs in the range, with great attention paid to comfort and safety. With more custom options than any other stairlift, the Starla can be tailored to suit your home, whether classic or contemporary.

Control at the Touch of a Button

The wall-mounted controls at the top and bottom of the stairs make it easy to call the stairlift wherever you are, or send it up or down for someone else to use. The Starla’s intuitive controls, designed for those with limited dexterity, work with the lightest of touches and can be operated using your hand, arm, or wrist.

The seat load sensor on the Starla 260 curved stairlift allows you to get comfortably seated before the chair moves. For extra security, simply fasten your seatbelt. The Starla can also remain swivelled at the top of the stairs, forming a secure barrier for your peace of mind.

Peace of Mind Features

Equipped with advanced safety features, the Starla 260 curved stairlift prioritises security. Its Safety Edges automatically bring the stairlift to a stop if an obstruction is detected. The one-handed seatbelt is ideal for users with limited dexterity, making it easier to fasten with comfort.

products.body_html:
Reconditioned Stannah Siena 260 Curved Stairlift

Which Colour? You Choose!

The Siena 260 curved stairlift pairs contemporary style with Stannah’s precision engineering. With five classic colour options and sleek contours, the Siena 260 is a stylish, practical addition to any home, designed to blend seamlessly with your décor.

Easy-to-Use Controls

Convenient wall-mounted controls at the top and bottom of the stairs make it easy to call the stairlift from any floor. When not in use, the Siena 260 folds neatly against the wall, providing ample space. The intuitive controls are designed for easy operation, especially beneficial for those with reduced dexterity, allowing use with a light touch by hand, arm, or wrist.

Smooth Landing Access

At the top of the stairs, the footrest aligns level with your landing, allowing safe and easy dismount. The swivel seat can be rotated manually using a lever, or opt for the powered swivel seat feature, which automatically positions the chair for a secure exit.
